## Architecture snapshot

**User-facing UI is the React SPA** under `frontend/` (Vite + React 19 + TypeScript). Flask is the JSON API + SPA host. Legacy Jinja templates / `app/static` are gone; `app/spa.py` 301-redirects old URLs to React routes while preserving query strings.

Data story for officials: **BBU Bayern** league + tournament results (~2006→ for leagues, tournaments partly to ~2000), searchable archive vs PDF/Excel result lists.

---

## 1. Public routes / URLs and what they show

| URL | Page | What officials see |
|-----|------|-------------------|
| `/` | Home | Brand hero, live stats (games, seasons, years, tournaments, players), Quick Start (Spieler / Club / Mein Club / Glossar), entity map (Akteure vs Wettbewerbe), explainers, curated deep-link examples, latest events |
| `/liga` | League | Cascading filters → standings, matchdays, team season analysis, game sheets |
| `/club` (`/mannschaft` → redirect) | Club | Club search → multi-team overview + team analytics; global club rankings when no club selected |
| `/spieler` | Player | Fuzzy search (name / EDV-ID) → career + season stats, highlights, trends |
| `/turnier` | Tournament | Podium archive → event detail (leaderboard, KO, rounds) → player drill-down |
| `/club-300` | Club 300 | All perfect games: bubble chart by season/level, tier ladder, sortable table |
| `/clubpokal` | Placeholder | “Demnächst verfügbar” only |
| `/glossar` | Glossary | Club / Team / Liga / Spieltag / Cutline / Hcp / Scratch / etc. |
| `/warum-bowlyzer` | Why Bowl-A-Lyzer | Motivation, BBU sources, formats, history timeline |
| `/impressum` | Legal | Impressum |

**DEV-only** (`import.meta.env.DEV`; production redirects `/diagnose/*` → `/`):

| URL | Purpose |
|-----|---------|
| `/diagnose/validierung` (+ liga / turniere / clubs) | Data-quality hub |
| `/diagnose/club-matrix` | Club × season league matrix |
| `/diagnose/liga-wochen` | League week coverage matrix |
| `/diagnose/daten-anomalien` | Oddities |
| `/diagnose/datenpipeline` | Pipeline status |
| `/diagnose/turnier-uebersicht` | Tournament coverage |
| `/diagnose/design-system` | Token playground |

**Legacy URL redirects** (query preserved):  
`/league/stats` → `/liga`, `/team/stats` → `/club`, `/player/stats` → `/spieler`, `/tournament/stats` → `/turnier`, etc.

---

## 2. Key interactive features by journey

### Liga (`/liga`) — filter cascade

**Filters (URL):** `season` (`latest` \| `all` \| `YY/YY`), `league`, `week`, `team`, `round` (+ `database`, `myClub`)

| Selection | Content |
|-----------|---------|
| Season only | All league standings for that season + honor scores per league |
| League + all seasons | Historical averages, points-to-win, top team/individual, record games |
| Season + league | Standings, timetable, position/points charts, team-vs-team matrix, individual averages |
| + week | Matchday table, honor scores, team-vs-team, best averages |
| Season + league + team | Team performance tables, win %, position/points charts, player scatter |
| + week + team | Score sheet views (classic etc.) + individual week averages |
| + round | Game overview / per-team game details (heatmap-capable Tabulator) |

**UX:** Contextual filter hint + link to Glossar; Mein Club narrows seasons/leagues/teams.

### Club (`/club`)

**Filters:** `club`, `team`, `season`

- **No club:** federation-flavored **Club Rankings** (pinfall, members, weekly averages, legends-style records).
- **Club overview:** position-history chart for all Mannschaften, **Club Legends**, team cards, compact season×league matrix (deep-links into Liga), **Club Player Results**.
- **Team detail:** placement history chart, special matches, vs league average, **clutch** (adjustable threshold), consistency metrics.

UI label is **Club**, not Verein (Mannschaft = numbered team under club).

### Spieler (`/spieler`)

**Filters:** `player_name` / `player` / `player_id`, `season` (`all` = career), `focus=search`

Lifetime cards, competition breakdown charts, highlights (best days, tournament finishes, etc.), trend chart. Mein Club scopes the player list to that club.

### Turnier (`/turnier`)

**Filters:** `season`, `tournament`, `round`, `player`

| Mode | Content |
|------|---------|
| No event | Podium overview tables (by season / tournament) |
| Season + tournament | Summary cards, best efforts, KO bracket (when configured), leaderboard, round results + optional heatmap |
| Player only | Cross-tournament player overview |
| Event + player | Per-player tournament section + field progress |

Format info via ℹ on the page. Separate tournament `database=` IDs when needed.

### Club 300 (`/club-300`)

Bubble chart (season × league level), player tier ladder, full games table — optionally Mein-Club filtered.

### Cross-cutting

- **Mein Club** (`?myClub=…`): ribbon on every page; filters Liga / Turnier / Spieler / Club 300 to that club’s participation.
- **`?database=`:** switches published data source; kept in URLs; synced via `/switch-database`. Default often `db_real_merged`.
- **DE/EN** language toggle (server translations via `/league/get_translations`).
- **Deep links** shareable; home “Beispiele” are curated federation demos (Bayernliga, BZOL, Nord-/Südbayerische Meisterschaft, sample club/player).

## 3. Demo / tour / onboarding (what exists)

Not a step wizard. Soft onboarding instead:

- Home hero + Quick Start + explainers (“Ligaspiel in 60 Sekunden”)
- Curated example deep links
- `/glossar` + per-page dismissible **ContextualHint**s
- `/warum-bowlyzer` narrative for officials/newcomers
- Persona notes (`homePersonaDecisions.ts`): CTA order Mein Club → latest results → player search; print/PDF deferred; DE-first

No product tour, no federation login/roles, no guided “BBU dashboard.”

---

## 4. Deep-link & `?database=` patterns

**Preserved across navigation:** `database`, `myClub` (sanitizer / `linkForPath`).

**Examples from home:**

- `/liga?season=22/23&database=db_real_merged`
- `/liga?season=25/26&league=BayL&week=2&team=BK%20München%203&database=…`
- `/turnier?season=25/26&tournament=Nordbayerische%20Meisterschaft`
- `/club?club=BC%20EMAX%20Unterföhring&database=…`
- `/spieler?player_name=…&player_id=25082&database=…`

Seasons in the address bar: `25/26`; API wire format may use `25-26` for nginx safety.

---

## 5. React frontend status — built, not scaffold

`CLAUDE.md` still says “bare scaffold”; **reality is a full strangler cutover**:

**Shipped:** Home, Liga (all filter modes), Club (+ rankings/legends), Spieler, Turnier (podiums/KO/player), Club 300, Glossar, Warum, Impressum, Mein Club, Database selector, Stadium design system, Tabulator + ECharts wrappers, diagnosis suite (dev).

**Not done / thin:** Clubpokal page; Verein layer; print/PDF; federation-wide executive dashboards; production diagnosis UI.

Flask blueprints remain API-only: `league_routes`, `team_routes`, `player_routes`, `tournament_routes`, `main` (`/home/stats`, DB switch, pipeline endpoints for diagnose).

---

## 6. German org hierarchy (as documented)

| Tier | Example | In app |
|------|---------|--------|
| National / state (DBU / BBU) | — | Not modeled as entities |
| **Verein** | BV 68 Regensburg | Not modeled; may appear raw on tournament rows |
| **Club** | Donaubowler Regensburg | First-class (`/club`, matrix, Mein Club) |
| **Team / Mannschaft** | `… Regensburg 2` | Full name + optional trailing number |

Glossary and `docs/planning/VEREIN_CLUB_DISAMBIGUATION.md` acknowledge Verein vs Club; mapping is **future**, not productized.

---

## 7. Notable data surfaces

- **Leagues:** multi-season standings, matchdays, honor scores, team-vs-team, records, history charts  
- **Tournaments:** regional/state championships, podiums, cuts, KO brackets, player career across events  
- **Players:** lifetime + season, league & tournament blended, EDV IDs  
- **Clubs:** multi-team history matrix, legends, cross-club rankings, Club 300 hall of fame  
- **History:** archive framing ~2006+; incomplete older seasons acknowledged on Warum page  

---

## What’s impressive vs typical federation sites

1. **Interactive archive** — not just current season PDFs  
2. **Filter-deep analytics** — position progress, clutch, consistency, team-vs-team matrices  
3. **Club lens** — all Mannschaften + legends + Mein Club personalization  
4. **Tournament sophistication** — KO, heatmaps, format metadata  
5. **Club 300** as a showcase feature  
6. **Shareable deep links** for specific matchdays / finals / players  
7. **Transparent data pipeline** (dev diagnose) — rare for federation public sites  

---

## Gaps federation officials would care about

| Gap | Why it matters |
|-----|----------------|
| **No Verein / BBU / district rollup** | Officials think Verein → Club → Team; app stops at Club |
| **No federation-wide “season dashboard”** | No single “all Bayern this week” ops view outside season-all-leagues standings |
| **Clubpokal missing** | Named in nav/glossary; placeholder only |
| **Diagnosis hidden in prod** | Coverage/validation useful for officials but not public |
| **No roles / official vs public** | Same UI for everyone; no sanctioned “official bulletin” mode |
| **Print/PDF export deferred** | Officials still live in printable result sheets |
| **Incomplete historical / OCR caveats** | Must set expectations in demos |
| **Verein labels in tournaments unresolved** | Can confuse identity vs league clubs |
| **i18n** | DE-first; EN secondary |

---

## Suggested demo journeys for BBU-style officials

1. **Home → Beispiel “Saison 22/23 alle Ligatabellen”** — archive power  
2. **Mein Club → Liga** — club-scoped season  
3. **Matchday + honor scores** — familiar “Ergebnisliste” upgraded  
4. **Club overview → legends → team clutch** — analytics beyond tables  
5. **Turnier podium → Finale + KO** — championship storytelling  
6. **Club 300** — memorable closer  
7. **Warum + Glossar** — credibility and vocabulary alignment  

**Bottom line for a federation pitch:** Bowl-A-Lyzer is a **club-/competition-centric live archive and analytics layer on BBU results**, not a Verein/association CRM or official results publisher replacement — strongest where PDF lists fail (search, history, multi-team clubs, tournament depth).
